name: grilling
title_zh: 连续追问直到你自相矛盾的方案压力测试器
tagline_zh: 做决策前总觉得自己想清楚了？让它连问二十个「为什么」，专挑你逻辑里最软的那块肉下嘴，直到你改口或认输。
tagline_en: Think you've thought it through? It fires 20 straight 'whys', targeting the softest spot in your logic until you.
desc_en: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.
why_zh: 不是给建议，是专门制造认知失调。每轮追问都基于你上一句回答。
why_en: No advice—engineered cognitive dissonance. Each follow-up builds on your last answer, forcing vague 'probablys' into testable.
limit_zh: 只对「计划、决定、想法」三类对象开火，不负责查资料、不算数据、不提供替代方案。你给不出明确前提，它只会一直问下去。
limit_en: Only grills plans, decisions, or ideas. No research, no math, no alternatives. Vague premises mean it just keeps asking.
title_en: Relentless plan stress-tester that grills until you.
